description: Implementation of AdminSettingsService for managing admin settings, including CRUD operations, validation, event publishing, and handling OAuth2 provider info changes.

classes.name: AdminSettingsServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for managing admin settings, including CRUD operations, validation, event publishing, and OAuth2 provider info handling.

methods.name: findAdminSettingsById
methods.description: Retrieves admin settings by ID for a specific tenant.

methods.name: findAdminSettingsByKey
methods.description: Retrieves admin settings by key for the system tenant.

methods.name: findAdminSettingsByTenantIdAndKey
methods.description: Retrieves admin settings by tenant ID and key.

methods.name: findAllByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves all admin settings for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: saveAdminSettings
methods.description: Validates and saves admin settings, handling special cases for 'mail' key and OAuth2 provider info changes, and publishes save events.

methods.name: deleteAdminSettingsByTenantIdAndKey
methods.description: Deletes admin settings by tenant ID and key.

methods.name: deleteByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all admin settings for a tenant.

methods.name: deleteEntity
methods.description: Deletes an admin settings entity by ID for a tenant.

methods.name: findEntity
methods.description: Finds an admin settings entity by ID for a tenant, returning an Optional.

methods.name: findEntityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds an admin settings entity by ID for a tenant.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is ADMIN_SETTINGS.

methods.name: dropTokenIfProviderInfoChanged
methods.description: Removes OAuth2 tokens if provider info has changed and OAuth2 is enabled.
